# Test basic framework generation for CoreGraphics
# This test verifies that the generator can process CoreGraphics
# and produce valid Go bindings.

# Run the generator for CoreGraphics
# Explicitly specify input directory to ensure it uses the cache
env INPUT_DIR=$HOME/.appledocs/cache/developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework CoreGraphics -input $INPUT_DIR -output testoutput
stdout 'Generated CoreGraphics bindings'

# The generator creates output in testoutput/coregraphics/
# Verify that key files were generated
exists testoutput/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
exists testoutput/coregraphics/types.gen.go

# Check that the generated functions file contains expected patterns
grep 'package coregraphics' testoutput/coregraphics/functions.gen.go

# Check that the types file was generated with proper structure
grep 'package coregraphics' testoutput/coregraphics/types.gen.go

# Verify at least some common CoreGraphics types are defined
grep 'CGRect' testoutput/coregraphics/types.gen.go
